summary: Frontend-only verification of /pricing bug fixes: slider smoothness (step=1000), new text input above slider, copy updates (eyebrow/heading/paragraph removal, em-dash removal), CTA removal, and price-grid regression. 9 of 11 checks fully pass; 2 minor rounding discrepancies (1p) in 4-to-5 beds Grade 2 combos.

issues: When 'Bespoke quote' state is active, the summary card no longer shows the CTA (as intended), but there is no alternative action or contact hint visible. The description ('Your combination sits outside our standard bands... tailored quote from our accredited surveyor panel.') is present but with no next step — worth noting for UX, not a bug per spec.

spec_checks.text_input_50_000_below_min: internal value=50,000, slider value attr=50,000 (below min clamps visually via CSS fill), price=£646.88 (tier-0 band) — PASS

action_items: MINOR: 1p rounding discrepancy in pricing calc for 4-to-5 beds + Grade 2/2* combos. Expected in spec: £1,221.88 / £1,413.55. Rendered: £1,221.89 / £1,413.56. Likely a floating-point / half-up-vs-half-even rounding difference in the fee formula. Confirm which value is the intended source of truth; if the .88/.55 figures from the spec are correct, adjust rounding (e.g., Math.round on cents with epsilon) in pricing.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Rounding: the two failing combos differ by only 1 penny — inspect the price calculation for float precision (e.g., 191.67 + 1030.21 vs mid-band tier). Consider computing in integer pence and dividing at the end.
For 'Bespoke quote' state consider surfacing a contact CTA (email/phone) since the buy CTA has been intentionally removed on the pricing-only page.
